summary: Comprehensive testing of two new AI Assistant SaaS Platform features: 1) Floating AI chat widget on landing page (guest chat without auth), 2) WhatsApp 2-way AI chat forwarding. ALL TESTS PASSED - 13 backend API tests and all frontend UI tests.

POST /api/guest/chat - Returns session_id starting with 'guest_'
POST /api/guest/chat - Responds in Arabic when asked in Arabic
POST /api/guest/chat - Maintains session with session_id parameter
POST /api/guest/chat - Rate limiting field 'limited' present in response
POST /api/whatsapp/ai - Returns AI response without authentication
POST /api/whatsapp/ai - Returns success: true on successful processing
POST /api/whatsapp/ai - Responds in Arabic when message is in Arabic
POST /api/whatsapp/ai - Messages logged to whatsapp_messages MongoDB collection (verified 5 messages)
GET /api/health - Health endpoint still working
GET /api/subscription/plans - Returns 3 plans (free, pro, business)
POST /api/auth/login - Login endpoint working with test credentials
GET /api/whatsapp/status - WhatsApp status endpoint working (requires auth)
GET /api/whatsapp/qr - WhatsApp QR endpoint working (requires auth)
Floating chat button visible on landing page (data-testid='floating-chat-button')
Clicking floating chat button opens chat window (data-testid='floating-chat-window')

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features fully tested and working: 1) Guest Chat API (POST /api/guest/chat) - no auth required, rate limited (10 msgs/5 min per IP), uses GPT-5.2, returns session_id. 2) WhatsApp AI endpoint (POST /api/whatsapp/ai) - no auth required, accepts phone_number and message, forwards to GPT-5.2, logs to MongoDB whatsapp_messages collection. The FloatingChat component is rendered at bottom of Landing.js with proper data-testid attributes. WhatsApp Node.js service forwards non-help messages to /api/whatsapp/ai via axios.
